title: recover-Q: bounded shared record band from 2^52, 117.525153583201

claims.statement: For the plain bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, uniform T=[x]P0 including identity, proof.md's algorithm returns canonical x with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT. For nonidentity T use z=e(T,Q0), h=e(P0,Q0), independent uniform b in [1,r), g=h^b; the cold STNFS core computes a=log_g(z) from two logarithms, and x=ba mod r is checked in G1. The complete core is the accepted recover-Q package stnfs-rec7-band52q (117.525153584), transferred unchanged: bounded shared record-walk extension over [2^52,2^56), f-only sieve with the exact FFT batch g test, f-only scan2 and the f-only norm-bound kernel, six owners, descent plan and meter 2^120.847081678041. Core ledger <= 2^117.5730562390 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions): collection <= 2^116.865873450, linear algebra <= 2^115.814110851, both logarithms metered at 2^113.29; wrapper <= 2^80 instructions, a 2^66 row. The plain bound is core + log2(10) = 2^120.847081678041 G1 units (C=2,000), the factor 10 being the C=20,000 to C=2,000 conversion. Core success >= 0.44748, >= 0.39 at +10% expected descent work. All cold construction, processors, failures, transfers and verification are included without amortization; no auxiliary powers, advice or amortisation. An analytic exploratory claim, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit: code identity, parameters, certificate, probes, SRT replay, band split, ledger, success, claim (80-digit decimals); {"descent": true} reruns the descent. evidence16.py (local) reruns every check.
